reason: A QQ Bot Platform bridge for sending private or group messages to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, with persistent sessions, model switching, allowlists, and one-time permission approvals.

summaries.zh: 将腾讯官方 QQ 机器人消息接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体会话，支持白名单、持久会话、模型切换和一次性权限审批。
summaries.en: Connects Tencent’s official QQ Bot Platform to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions with allowlists, persistent conversations, model switching, and one-time permission approvals.

capabilities: Connects Tencent QQ Bot Platform messages to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions
Stores and uses QQ bot credentials, user OpenIDs, and a DeepSeek API key from local environment files
Maintains persistent conversations and supports model switching
Processes one-time agent permission approvals through QQ commands
Sends streamed agent responses to QQ and retries failed sends
